_about: Build 2026-11-16b (test 55's fixes on top of 2026-11-16a's art: the first-person camera's place, the view bike near the camera in third person, Parent's moves, the view's lean by the turning rate, the look back's pitch, A/D 0.45; the worn bike, the holstered gun and outfit pieces near the eye hidden with the body, the first-person arms hidden looking back, the body's eye; the put-away calling the game, saves not counted, the handgun seated with both hands on the bars and the gun in hand, drawing right after getting on; the field kit's preview placed by the plugin; a short 1st with an even climb and the gears' sound at the matching speeds), packaged on 2026-11-10a's package as the asset base with 2026-11-16a's four overlays laid over it unchanged, in the same order (OVERLAY=<1>:<2>:<3>:<4>: /opt/cmb/assets15b/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/a/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/b/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/c/Data, the later winning). No new art: every asset is the 2026-11-16a package's, byte for byte. Keys starting with _ are comments. What differs from the 2026-11-16a package, in two kinds: (1) the commit's own shipped files, checked against the commit by the tracked-files check and never listed in vs_previous (verify_zips.py --list-changes compares only the assets and the compiled scripts): Data/CommonwealthMotorbike.esp (three GLOB values), Data/F4SE/Plugins/CMB_Slope.ini, Data/MCM/Config/CommonwealthMotorbike/config.json (four helps), Data/Scripts/Source/User/CMB_ControllerScript.psc, and Data/F4SE/Plugins/CMB_Slope.dll once the build's DLL is committed (at abad9ca the commit still holds 5b04dbf's DLL, which is the 2026-11-16a package's: the package takes the DLL from the commit, so tools/f4se-slope/build.sh's DLL has to be committed first; git diff --stat 5b04dbf <the build's commit> -- Data lists them); (2) the compiled scripts and assets, below (vs_previous): only CMB_ControllerScript.pex.
_previous: The 2026-11-16a package: the verifier's --previous (/opt/cmb/out/2026-11-16a/CommonwealthMotorbike_2026-11-16a). The asset base is 2026-11-10a's Data (assets.sha256), with 2026-11-16a's four overlays.

_vs_previous: What verify_zips.py --list-changes compares: the assets (the files under Data/Meshes/CMB, Textures/CMB, Materials/CMB, Sound/FX/CMB and the riding clips' folder) and the compiled scripts (Data/Scripts/*.pex, by their code, not their headers) against the 2026-11-16a package. No asset differs (the same base and overlays); one compiled script does, CMB_ControllerScript (its source changed: the put-away's seconds counted while the game runs, CMB_RoomOptions bit 1024), null accepting its bytes (its header carries the packaged commit's time); CMB_LookF4SE and the other ten keep their code under a new header. The commit's own files that change (the ESP, CMB_Slope.dll and CMB_Slope.ini, config.json, the .psc: _about) are not in this block.
